Simplistic Strawberry Ricotta Parfait
By: Katrin
Published: Thursday, April 14, 2011 - 1:31pm

Ingredients




1 tub smooth low fat ricotta
1/4 cup icing sugar
1 teaspoon lemon zest
1/2 teaspoon clear vanilla
1 pint strawberries, washed, hulled and sliced
4 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs

Preparation

1 In the ricotta tub add the icing sugar, zest and vanilla and stir until smooth and combined. 2 Now you are ready to layer. 3 Grab a parfait glass, scoop a few teaspoons into the dish, add a handful of strawberries and sprinkle on the graham cracker crumbs.  Start again. 4 Keep layering until you are satisfied with the amount rising up and over the top, I like to end with strawberries

About


Light, refreshing dessert for patio season!
